name: eq-vocal
description: Mud cut plus presence lift, pillar vs edge vs air. Filter voices and male/female directions without harshness.
notes: Precondition: Vocal track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-vocal.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Mud ease in the low-mid (~0.4); low-cut / pillar / edge / air manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
